mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log_integrity_head (scope_type, scope_id, current_hash) VALUES (#{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{currentHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_type = scope_type
mapper.select: SELECT scope_type, scope_id, next_chain_index, current_hash FROM audit_log_integrity_head WHERE scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} FOR UPDATE
